description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmailConfigurationAPI, specifically testing the retrieval, update, and deletion methods of the API for email configurations within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes setup with test data, mocked services, and data providers for parameterized tests.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailConfiguration API endpoints related to email configuration management in OrangeHRM.
